assessment: This study focuses on the regulation of GLP-1 in enteroendocrine L cells and how this may be stimulated by the mechanogated ion channel Piezo1 and the CaMKKbeta-CaMKIV-mTORC1 signaling pathway. The work is innovative and is considered valuable, as the hypothesis that is being tested may have significant mechanistic and translational implications. Data to support the proposed mechanism were considered incomplete, yet data to support the overall physiological characterization were considered solid.
